contamination_check.method: 13-token polynomial rolling hash (uint64, mod 2**64 via numpy wraparound) computed shard-by-shard (<=1 shard resident in RAM at a time, peak <=512MB, not the full 13.6GB) -- re-implements the SAME exact-match semantics as scripts/proofs/contamination_verbatim_check.py (GPT-3 decontamination convention, window_tokens=13, Brown et al. arXiv:2005.14165), because that tool own method (materialize every window as a Python tuple in a set) does not scale to ~7e9 windows. Every hash hit is re-verified by an exact elementwise comparison against the actual on-disk token ids -- a hash collision can only cost extra verification work, never a false verdict. Shard-to-shard BOUNDARY windows (25 joins) were also checked, since PackedShardLoader concatenates all 26 shards into one stream before windowing.
